status: modeling guidance; not actual company distribution data

principles.rule: Determine national versus regional brand availability before assigning demand coverage. Separate company, brand and SKU footprints.
Allocate baseline consumer demand using Census population geography, including suburban and rural areas; do not use DC positions as demand centroids.
Adjust population-weighted demand for retail door coverage, category purchase propensity, and channel mix. Unknown retail coverage must be labeled assumed.
Classify emerging, regional, expanding-national, or national distribution with evidence; do not infer coverage from plant location.
Separate imported finished goods from domestically manufactured products. Do not assume Virginia facilities originate Bonne Maman shipments.
Infer distributor and retailer DC service territories from geography and transport economics, not by treating DCs as consumer demand.
